Finding a programme
Our degree programmes
Find your degree programme!
With more than 180 Bachelor’s, Diploma and Master’s degree programmes, the University of Vienna offers you the widest range of degree programmes in Austria. The range covers all academic disciplines – from Education, Philosophy and Religion through to History, Society and Culture, right up to Mathematics, Computer Science, Natural Sciences and Technology. It also includes Health, Psychology, Sport, Languages, as well as Economics and Law.
Select a type of degree programme (e.g. Bachelor’s and Diploma programmes) and browse our range of options. For each programme, you will find a dedicated programme profile containing information on course content, entry requirements, career and further education opportunities, and more.

How to choose?
Are you still unsure about what you’d like to study? Or whether a degree programme is right for you at all? Use our advisory services!
Is university the right choice for me?
The uni:check is a virtual tour of a bachelor's programme at the University of Vienna, featuring interactive activities and videos. What does it actually mean to study at the University of Vienna?
Click here for uni:check!

Is this degree programme right for me?
Online self-assessments (OSAs) are currently available for 39 degree programmes. Find out about the key areas of study and see whether the degree programme meets your expectations.
Go to the OSAs
With ‘Studieren Probieren’, you can get a taste of a degree programme whilst accompanied by current students. The programme is organised by the Austrian National Union of Students (ÖH).
